card.name: Linking words mid-sentence before a noun
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, for, so, among, why and 's in the middle of a clause, right before the noun phrase that completes it. Also some nouns like warning or products that are followed by more of the phrase.

modes.label: Prepositions before a noun
modes.description: Words like of, for and among that open a phrase whose noun comes next.
modes.example: aspirate as much<< of>> the suspension as possible

modes.label: Clause connectors
modes.description: Words like why and so that start a clause with its subject still to come.
modes.example: They want to know<< why>> some diabetic patients do not develop complications.

modes.label: Modifier nouns or possessive
modes.description: A possessive 's or modifying word that needs a following noun to finish.

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in the middle of a sentence where the phrase is not yet finished.
